documents.title: Note - bathroom silicone - things to remember
documents.content:
Notes app — saved 31 May 2025, 16:22

bathroom silicone job — notes for next time

- DO NOT use the stanley blade on old silicone, use the plastic scraper first then blade for the stubborn bits. I gouged the tile edge near the tap side, not loads but annoying
- The pink stuff (mould remover spray) needs longer than you think. Left it 10 min, should have been 20 at least
- Tape lines — worth doing. Didn't bother, cost me a wobbly edge on the back corner which I had to smooth about six times
- Unibond 300 tube from B&Q was fine. Don't bother with the £12 one.
- Fan on for 24hrs after. Told Donna, hopefully she'll remember
- Took about 4 hours start to finish. Could be 2 if not an idiot

documents.title: Note - knee exercises (current version)
documents.content:
Knee exercises — do these

From Anita (physio, City Hospital, seen November)

1. Straight leg raises — 3 sets of 15, both legs
2. Clamshells — resistance band (blue one, drawer under bed)
3. Step-downs — bottom stair, controlled, 3 x 10 each leg
4. Wall sits — 30 sec hold, build up to 60

Every morning before work if possible. She said quad weakness is the main issue — VMO specifically. Won't feel like it's working for 7–10 days.

DO NOT rely on ibuprofen. It's masking it.

Book follow-up appointment if no improvement by end of February.
Anita's number: 0121 554 3801 ext 4 (leave message)

Last updated: 15 Jan 2025

documents.content:

From Anita (physio, City Hospital, seen November)

1. Straight leg raises — 3 sets of 15, both legs
2. Clamshells — resistance band (blue one, drawer under bed)

documents.content:
LEMON CAKE – ELISE 8TH

Used Nigella recipe but halved it roughly – think the oven was too hot, bottom right came out darker. Next time: 160 fan not 170, and rotate tin at 25 min mark.

2 eggs (should have been 2.5 if halving properly – rounds weirdly)
150g butter
150g caster sugar
Zest of 1.5 lemons
Juice of 1 lemon for the drizzle

Elise didn't notice the overdone side. Put that side facing the wall. Icing sugar went everywhere because of the drilling – had to do it again. She wanted it in the garden which was fine until about 3:30.

She liked it. Write this down properly before I forget.

8 candles. Made her a wish. Didn't say what.

documents.title: Birthday cake – notes/recipe fragment
documents.content:
LEMON CAKE – ELISE 8TH

Used Nigella recipe but halved it roughly – think the oven was too hot, bottom right came out darker. Next time: 160 fan not 170, and rotate tin at 25 min mark.

2 eggs (should have been 2.5 if halving properly – rounds weirdly)
150g butter
150g caster sugar
Zest of 1.5 lemons
Juice of 1 lemon for the drizzle

Elise didn't notice the overdone side. Put that side facing the wall. Icing sugar went everywhere because of the drilling – had to do it again. She wanted it in the garden which was fine until about 3:30.

She liked it. Write this down properly before I forget.

8 candles. Made her a wish. Didn't say what.

documents.content:

documents.title: Boiler Top-Up Notes (Keep)
documents.content:
Boiler pressure fix - notes for next time

Pressure dropped to 0.8 bar again (should be between 1 and 1.5)

YouTube video that worked: "How to repressurise Worcester Bosch boiler" - bloke in blue jumper, NOT the one with the woman in it, that one is different model

Steps:
1. Make sure boiler is OFF and cooled down
2. Find filling loop under boiler - two grey valves, left side of cupboard
3. Open BOTH valves slowly - you'll hear water
4. Watch pressure gauge on front - stop at 1.2
5. Close both valves, turn boiler back on
6. Check for drips after 10 mins

Took about 4 minutes total. Easy.

Boiler make: Worcester Bosch Greenstar 28i
Installed 2019 probably

If it drops again before end of month call someone - might be a leak somewhere

documents.title: Boiler Top-Up Notes (Keep)
documents.content:
Boiler pressure fix - notes for next time

Pressure dropped to 0.8 bar again (should be between 1 and 1.5)

YouTube video that worked: "How to repressurise Worcester Bosch boiler" - bloke in blue jumper, NOT the one with the woman in it, that one is different model

Steps:
1. Make sure boiler is OFF and cooled down
2. Find filling loop under boiler - two grey valves, left side of cupboard
3. Open BOTH valves slowly - you'll hear water
4. Watch pressure gauge on front - stop at 1.2
5. Close both valves, turn boiler back on
6. Check for drips after 10 mins

Took about 4 minutes total. Easy.

Boiler make: Worcester Bosch Greenstar 28i
Installed 2019 probably

If it drops again before end of month call someone - might be a leak somewhere

documents.content:

PROJECT: The Perennial Podcast — Series 2
Client: Rowena Achike / Tall Grass Media
Deadline: 29 November 2024

Ep 4 — DONE. Sent for approval Mon. Awaiting feedback.

General: Client happy with loudness target of -16 LUFS for Spotify. Export as stereo WAV then MP3 320.

Invoice when ep 6 delivered. Rate: £180/ep = £540 total.

Don't want to write a long thing about this. Just — sort out contracts. Get the deposit clause in writing next time. Every time.

Thursday 21 Nov, late.

documents.title: sump pump notes FINAL
documents.content:
sump pump fix - friday/saturday

Model confirmed: Wayne CDU980 (label on side, SN W19-04471)
Issue: impeller clogged + worn seal, not bearing (bearing was fine)

Part bought: Wayne Impeller/Seal Kit, Home Depot SKU 679-204, $67.43 incl tax

Install steps:
- power off at breaker (not just unplug)
- disconnect discharge pipe at union fitting
- remove float switch assembly first
- 4x Phillips screws on motor housing base
- old impeller had debris packed in (gravel + what looked like hardened sediment)
- replaced seal while in there

Took about 90 min total. Test run good, no grinding, float cycling normally.

Keep receipt. Warranty on part: 1 year.

Under section 4.2 of our tenancy agreement, the landlord is responsible for maintaining the heating system in working order. I'd be grateful if you could arrange to reimburse this within 14 days.

Thanks,
Marcus
